jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer - Solutions
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.About the jobReady to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together! We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer you will create solutions through selection of standard components and detailed engineering combined. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc., and they are delivered as equipment packages or skid solutions. Work involves both new development and standardization of solutions to bring down lead time on customer projects. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Manager, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, Workshops and customers.Key tasks and responsibilities:    Use P&ID + mass balance to design process solutions in Autodesk Inventor    Selection of standard components matching process needs    3D pipe routing using Inventor Piping/Sovelia    Detailed Engineering of skid solutions, including fabrication documentation    DFM in collaboration with workshop    FAT, piping line walk and SAT    Standardization of 3D design templates using skeleton and iLogic    Review 3D designs and 2D drawings    Review technical specifications from customers and develop technical deviation lists.    Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking    Agile project execution using MS DevOps    Ensure that the quality management system is followed Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning are part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work!At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.Joining Alfa Laval means being part of a flat, open, and inclusive culture that values collaboration and empowers employees. The company supports continuous learning and career development, fostering a strong growth mindset. As an established yet nimble global organization with 300+ locations and a long heritage of innovation, Alfa Laval offers both stability and autonomy often found in smaller firms. You will also gain meaningful cross-cultural exposure by working with international teams on impactful projects. Who are youYou are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.What you knowWe are looking for you with solid skills and experience in project execution within the wastewater, fluid handling, or a related processing industry.Requirements:     Degree in mechanical engineering.    Strong understanding of P&ID, piping, and detailed engineering.    Experience in driving standardization within piping and flange designs.    Familiarity with GEP, CE marking and ATEX requirements.    Understanding relevant industry standards and regulations, including ISO and ASME.    Excellent communication skills in English For more information, please contactJesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner atWe are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.Our commitment to integrityWe care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. jobs.occupation: We are looking for a dedicated employee for our Supply Department
jobs.description:

The role in Supply is a vital part of Newrest’s operations, and contributes to a safe, accurate and efficient operation of the warehouse inventory. This role ensures that the inventory is accurate daily and that full Inventory counts are done according to local guidelines.

Responsibilities:

Receiving:

• 
Assisting when needed and the first point of entry for our products

• 
Restacking pallets for counting date coding and item numbering

• 
Rejecting any product that does not meet our quality standards

 Inventory Control:

• 
Ensuring all boxes have codes, receipt dates and expiration dates

• 
First in First Out (FIFO) – First Expired First Out (FEFO)

• 
Ensuring all boxes are closed and on pallets

• 
Ensuring any decanted products are in plastic crates

• 
Repacking pallets and putting them away into their correct locations

Communication:

• 
 Via messaging platforms

• 
Use Winrest to control our inventory

Gate Keeping:

• 
Recounting any product that leaves the warehouse (Verification at the gate)

• 
Taking photos of products leaving the warehouse with the label showing

• 
Ensuring products are correctly decanted

• 
Ensuring the Output Forms (OF) are accurate on Winrest from other departments and from within the warehouse

Inventory Counts:

• 
 Daily cycle counts (Top moving and highest value)

• 
Change shifts to accommodate the Company inventory counts every 10 days

• 
Swap another day off to ensure that the full team is at the inventory count

• 
Participate in the counting and inputting of the inventory from start to finish

• 
Understand and be accountable for inventory discrepancies

• 
Ensure warehouse organization & stock rotation including cleanliness

• 
Reporting of discrepancies with corrective actions to stop issues reoccurring

• 
Compliance with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP)/General manufacturing practices (GMP) guidelines for personal hygiene and observe security precautions as mandated by unit management.

Profile:

 Qualifications:

• 
 High School diploma or equivalent.

• 
Previous experience in warehouse operations, stock counting, or logistics preferred.

• 
Attention to detail and ability to work efficiently under pressure.

• 
Forklift certification is a plus.

• 
Must be able to read, write and speak English and preferably Danish (not a must)

• 
You must live in Denmark of Sweden. Applicants who do not live in Denmark or Sweden will not be taken into consideration.

• 
Permanent working permit is a plus.

Some of your tasks require lifting and pushing pallets in an occasionally cold environment, so you must be in good physical shape. 

You must be able to perform and maintain a background check throughout the employment as you must be eligible for working in Denmark. This includes an unmarked criminal record.

We are looking forward to receiving your cv (you do not have to submit a cover letter) as soon as possible. The opening is closed as soon as we get the ideal candidates.

If you haven't heard from us, no later than 14 days after applying, we have moved on with other candidates.

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technicians
jobs.description:
Are you a Maintenance Technician looking for a stable and rewarding career in a high‑tech production environment? Do you want to work with state‑of‑the‑art automation and electrical systems while developing your skills with the potential to progress into a leadership role?

At C&D Foods (Denmark), we take pride in producing high‑quality pet food that customers and pet owners trust. As a key member of our engineering team, you will play a vital role in maintaining our commitment to excellence by ensuring all products meet the highest food safety and quality standards. You will work as part of a team of multi‑skilled technicians, apprentices, and contractors to maintain, install, and improve processing equipment across production areas (kitchen operations, filling, packing, and site services).

We are looking for highly motivated professionals to strengthen our technical team. We offer a dynamic work environment, modern technology, and a strong team culture where your expertise will make a real difference!

About the position

Your key areas of responsibility:

• 
Maintenance Operations

• 
Automation & Electrical Systems

Examples of tasks could be:

• 
Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair automation and electrical systems within the production facility

• 
Carry out preventive maintenance to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimize downtime

• 
Be proactive in completing corrective work orders and responding to maintenance issues and breakdowns

• 
Contribute to the ongoing development of the preventive maintenance schedule (PM strategy) by providing feedback and improvement suggestions

• 
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement enhancements using world‑class engineering and CI techniques

• 
Work close with production and other internal departments to ensure equipment reliability and maintain up‑to‑date documentation

In addition to the examples mentioned above, all maintenance and engineering activities must comply with applicable Health & Safety, food safety, and quality standards, ensuring full adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements relevant to food and pet food production environments.

Your profile

• 
Relevant mechanical and/or electrical experience)

• 
Fluent in English (It will be an advantage if you speak Danish or are currently learning it).

• 
Experience with PLC systems, automation, and industrial electrical installations is a plus.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently

• 
You have a "can do attitude"

• 
A proactive team player with a structured and solution-oriented mindset

• 
Open to learning and growing into a leadership role in the future

We offer

You will become part of the C&D Foods family, an international company with a multicultural environment, across nationalities and cross-functional teams, where collaboration, diversity, and inclusion are part of everyday life. We prioritize employee well-being, work-life balance, and personal development.

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Health and dental insurance

• 
3 × 12‑hour shift pattern

• 
4 consecutive days off

• 
Modern automation and production technology

• 
Continuous learning and technical development

• 
Broad exposure across multiple disciplines

• 
Supportive and collaborative team culture

You will take on a responsible role with varied tasks in an international company with a solid financial foundation and strong values.

How to apply

Please send your CV describing your interest in the position. Please note that applications should only be submitted via our website and not by other means.

About C&D Foods

C&D Foods is one of Europe’s leading producers of private label pet food, manufacturing a wide range of both wet and dry food. The company’s headquarters are located in Mullingar, County Westmeath.

As part of ABP Food Group, C&D Foods has grown to become one of the industry’s leading pet food manufacturers.

C&D Foods currently operates 9 production facilities across 7 countries (Ireland, United Kingdom, France, Denmark, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands) as well as 2 sales offices in Manchester and Italy.

jobs.occupation: Personal Assistant to the Sales Director
jobs.description:
Are you naturally organised, commercially curious and motivated by working close to business decisions? Do you enjoy connecting people, keeping things moving and making sure the details are in place? 

Then this could be your opportunity to take on a central role in SELECTED's international sales organisation.

YOUR TEAMYou will become part of SELECTED's international wholesale organisation, working closely with the Sales Director and Sales Management Team. From this central position, you will collaborate with colleagues across departments and markets, helping connect people, priorities and business initiatives.You will also work closely with the PA network across SELECTED and take part in the strategic steering group, giving you insight into the decisions and priorities shaping our sales organisation.

YOUR ROLEAs Personal Assistant to our Sales Director, you will combine business support, coordination and project-related responsibilities with the day-to-day tasks that keep a busy sales organisation running smoothly. You will work closely with the Sales Director as a trusted sparring partner, contributing your own perspectives, asking questions and challenging ideas when you see opportunities to do things differently.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Coordinating and following up on projects and strategic initiatives across the Wholesale organisation.

• 
Preparing presentations, business updates and management materials that support discussions and decisions.

• 
Supporting business reporting, KPI follow-up and the preparation of relevant insights.

• 
Working with colleagues across departments and markets to ensure clear communication and progress on agreed actions.

• 
Managing day-to-day PA responsibilities, including meeting preparation, minutes, scheduling and practical coordination.

• 
Improving processes and exploring how AI and digital tools can simplify administrative tasks and ways of working.

YOUR BENEFITSAt SELECTED, you'll have the opportunity to get close to the business and build valuable experience in an international sales organisation. You can look forward to:

• 
Working directly with the Sales Director and getting involved in the priorities and initiatives shaping our commercial direction.

• 
Collaborating with colleagues across markets and departments, building relationships and gaining insight into different parts of the business.

• 
Taking ownership of your work, contributing your ideas and developing your skills through varied responsibilities.

YOUR PROFILEYou are curious about business, naturally outgoing and enjoy working with people across different teams and levels. You find it easy to build relationships and bring structure to a busy environment. You take initiative, speak up when you have a different perspective and are comfortable questioning decisions when something doesn't make sense. At the same time, you take pride in getting the practical details right and following through on your commitments.Your background could be in business support, coordination or a related field, but previous experience as a Personal Assistant is not essential. What matters most is your willingness to take responsibility for both the administrative and business-related aspects of the role.

We also imagine that you:

• 
Have strong organisational skills and know how to prioritise when several things need your attention.

• 
Are comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.

• 
Are interested in AI, digital tools and using data to support better decisions.

• 
Are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish.

Experience from the fashion industry or knowledge of German would be an advantage, but neither is a requirement.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Pernille Dyrendom Thøgersen, Personal Assistant, on +45 30 85 33 58. Otherwise send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

jobs.description:

Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues. •  	Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.

•  	Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.  	   Graphic design & visual content:

•  	Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.

•  	Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.  	    	
•  	Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.  	   Social media support :    	
•  	Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.

The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license.
